sources: Hits, frames, keys and events: rmxlinux Json/SkillData chr_0038_purrche_* and Json/BuffData buff_chr_0038_purrche_* (game 1.6), as compiled by efsim kit-draft for the basic attacks, finisher, dive and counter; the shield, the giftbox and the Prezzies written from the data by hand (the compiler emits every random alternative). Values: SkillPatchTable (level 12), PotentialTalentEffectTable, CharacterPotentialTable. Report docs/kit-batches/batch-3/chr_0038_purrche.md, § Kit plan and § Kit (2026-10-20).

Skill timing from SkillData (the loader): normal_skill exclusive 50 and its CastSkill of normal_skill_loop_1 at 49; the loops (helper skills, batch 3 S4) hold her until the shield drops (exclusive 361); the combo's conditional jumps at 0 (KitSkill.jumps, D1), its end at 206 and MarkCanInterrupt 28 (S1); the ultimate's jump 67 → 135.

Not modelled: damage taken (Protection and its step-down, talent 2 "Ambassador's Duty": a defender-side reduction at full HP, N2), heal amounts (Will-based), the enemy being interrupted, pulled or knocked back, layer-1 dilations at blocks, projectile travel (test 47), swaps ending the shield, and which enemy hits a block counts (CheckDamageDecorateMask 805306368: every attack assumed) or the grab branch.

stacks.label: A block in this battle skill (buff_chr_0038_purrche_block_counter at 2+ layers)
Your sorry came LATE!: layers for the next ultimate's Ambassador's Special chance (buff_chr_0038_purrche_ult_add_red)
The last Giftbox item (buff_chr_0038_purrche_combo_lasttype combotype: 1 Handicraft, 2 Bomb, 3 Yummy Dessert; 0 none yet)
A shielded combo before its listener (frames 210–220 / 270–280: an attack isn't blocked)

buffs.label: I'M NOT SLEEPING!: shield up
buffs.note: buff_chr_0038_purrche_aura_block, created at normal_skill frame 0 (duration ← display_time_1, 3 s). PauseBuffTime while block_1 / block_2 / a shielded combo play, until their pause_block ends (block_1 0–9, block_2 0–11, combo 210–251 / 270–310): written as extendBuff by those lengths (triggers block_1_cast, block_2_cast, combo_shielded*). At the first block (block_counter reaching 2) SetBuffDuration 3.0 (a literal): the block_1_cast trigger re-applies it. It ends with a dash (buff_common_dash), an ultimate (CheckSkillType 7) and any skill that doesn't inherit it (inheritSkillIdList: block_1/2, loop_1/2, combo, counter; the counter finishes it at its frame 0). Its end creates block_end, on which the loops jump to 360 (trigger shield_end). Swaps (its swap events 2/3) aren't modelled.

buffs.label: I'M NOT SLEEPING!: Protection (self and nearby operators)
buffs.note: buff_chr_0038_purrche_block (AuraAction on nearby operators) → buff_chr_0038_purrche_block_instance: ShelterAction dmg_taken_down (attribute 63), while the shield is up (it follows shield_up here: same pauses, re-applied at the first block, ended with it). Its modifier makes it a Protection-category buff for buffApplied triggers (Eternal Xiranite); damage taken isn't simulated, so it has no other effect. The step-down after blocks ("Protection … is reduced after every blocked attack") isn't written: SkillPatchTable dmg_taken_down_2..4 (0.8 / 0.7 / 0.6) and block_instance's shelter_add −0.2 per block_shelter_down layer disagree (report row 10).

buffs.label: Battle skill changed to LEAVE MY FRIENDS ALONE!
buffs.note: buff_chr_0038_purrche_block_change_skill, created at normal_skill frame 0: its BuffData blackboard duration 10 (not assigned by the skill; a buff default, not a skill key), and its ChangeSkillAction normal_skill → normal_skill_counter (duration 10, lifeTimeType 2). Paused during the ultimate (pause_change_skill_buff, ultimate frames 0–146: trigger counter_paused_by_ult). The counter finishes it at its frame 0. Assumed: its finishWithNextSkillIfNotInherited with an empty inherit list doesn't end it (the loops list the counter in their windows over their whole length).

buffs.label: Ambassador's Special: Arts Susceptibility
buffs.note: buff_chr_0038_purrche_ult_spell_vulnerable (duration ← duration_vul 5 s; stackingType 2, maxStackCnt 3), created on the target by ult_skill_projhit before its DamageAction: VulnerableAction subType 1 (Arts) → child buff_chr_0038_purrche_vulnerable_spell_child (rate ← rate_vul, 0.025, P5 ×1.2). Assumed: layers (one per Ambassador's Special, each its own 5 s) add up (the child is priority-keyed with stackingType 0).

triggers.note: normal_skill frame 0: ObtainCostAction costType 1 atb_return_1 (atbGainMethod 1: returned, "immediately returns some SP"; potential_5_atb is 0 at every level and no potential sets it), CreateBuff aura_block, block (Protection aura), block_counter (a new count), block_change_skill. Team energy: buff_common_obtain_ultimate_sp at frame 0 (no ratio), the default.
normal_skill [49] CastSkill normal_skill_loop_1: the shield holds her (the loop runs until the shield drops). Dropped when a block or the counter ends normal_skill first.

EventListenerAction abilityEvent 101 (Purrchena is hit; CheckDamageDecorateMask checkType 3, mask 805306368, assumed to pass every enemy attack) → CastSkill normal_skill_block_1, in normal_skill [0–50], loop_1 [0–360] and the shielded combo [221–251]: wherever she is while the shield is up and no block has happened yet. The abilityEvent 9 branch (one enemy's grab, buff_eny_0018_lbtough_pre_catch) isn't modelled. With dodging on she doesn't dash where a block listener runs (KitSkill.noDodge on normal_skill [0, 50], loop_1 and loop_2 [0, 360], the blocks [3, 24] / [2, 25]): the attack is blocked. The shielded combo's listener ranges [221–251] and [281–310] aren't covered (one range per skill; its path decides them).

Listeners → CastSkill normal_skill_block_2 in block_1 [3–24], loop_2 [0–360], block_2 [2–25] and the shielded combo after a block [281–310]. The blocks' first 2–3 frames (no listener yet) aren't told apart.

"The first successful block extends the shield up duration and returns additional SP": aura_block on block_counter ≥ 2 the first time: SetBuffDuration 3.0 (the remaining time set to 3 s: re-applied); block_1 frame 0: PauseBuffTime of the aura until pause_block [0–9] ends (+9 frames), ObtainCostAction costType 1 atb_return_2 (20, returned), costType 0 talent_1_usp (talent 1: 6 / 10 energy; 0 without it), CompareFloat talent_1_usp > 0 → CreateBuff ult_add_red (one layer, max 3, lifeType 1). Its DamageAction is disabled; InterruptAction on the attacker and the layer-1 dilations have no effect here.
block_1 [23] CastSkill normal_skill_loop_2 (at 9 instead when the shield ended meanwhile: the paused aura can't end then, so not written).
block_2 frame 0: PauseBuffTime of the aura until pause_block [0–11] ends (+11 frames). Its DamageAction is disabled.
block_2 [22] CastSkill normal_skill_loop_2 (at 12 if the shield ended: not written, as for block_1).

aura_block's end creates block_end; the loops' EventListenerAction [0–360] (abilityEvent 9 with block_end) → JumpToAction 360: she's free at their exclusiveFrame 361 (MarkCanInterrupt 361); loop_1 ends at 491 (InterruptCurSkillAction). The Protection aura goes with the shield.
normal_skill_counter frame 0: FinishBuff aura_block, block_counter, block_change_skill, block_counter_mark.
aura_block ends with the next skill that doesn't inherit it (finishWithNextSkillIfNotInherited) and on an ultimate cast (CheckSkillType 7). While the shield holds her only the ultimate can start.
aura_block: abilityEvent 9 with buff_common_dash ends it (a dash; the engine's dashes are perfect dodges).

Ultimate CreateBuff pause_change_skill_buff [0–146] (autoFinishByAction) pauses block_change_skill: frames 0–67 and 135–146 are played (the jump 67 → 135), 78 real frames. The ultimate's time stop (TimeDilationAction layer 0 [0–135], cut by the jump: 69 frames) already holds every buff that long in the engine, so 9 frames more.
CharGrowthTable chr_0038_purrche_ComboSkill: "When the controlled operator is attacked" (game code; no trigger action in the data).

The shielded combo (the skill's jump at 0 → 210): aura_block paused from the cast until pause_block [210–251] ends, 41 frames (cut short if a block ends the combo first: not modelled). Written as 41 − 23: the engine already holds every buff for what the combo's slow-downs cost the world (23 frames on this path: the frame-0 slow-down kept at the jump's own frame, and the one at 270 that the cast at 250 never reaches; see the report), so the shield lasts the data's 41 frames longer. Until frame 221 no listener: an attack isn't blocked (combo_unguarded).
combo [221] EventListenerAction (abilityEvent 101 → block_1 / block_2) starts: 11 frames after the cast.
combo [250] CastSkill normal_skill_loop_1: back to the shield's hold, 40 frames after the cast.

The shielded combo (the skill's jump at 0 → 270): aura_block paused from the cast until pause_block [270–310] ends, 40 frames (cut short if a block ends the combo first: not modelled). Written as 40 − 13: the engine already holds every buff for what the combo's slow-downs cost the world (13 frames on this path: the frame-0 slow-down kept at the jump's own frame; see the report), so the shield lasts the data's 40 frames longer. Until frame 281 no listener: an attack isn't blocked (combo_unguarded).
combo [281] EventListenerAction (abilityEvent 101 → block_1 / block_2) starts: 11 frames after the cast.
combo [309] CastSkill normal_skill_loop_2: back to the shield's hold, 39 frames after the cast.
Another skill ended the shielded combo before its listener (its delayed reset is dropped with it).

skills.label: Battle skill: I'M NOT SLEEPING!
skills.note: No damage: raises the shield (triggers battle_cast, battle_loop, block_*, shield_*). The battle slot shows the counter for 10 s after the cast (ChangeSkillAction; counter_ready).

skills.label: Shield up (hold)
skills.note: Helper skill (SkillData only; the loader gives it normal_skill's group and values). IfElse [0–1]: enter_normal_skill_end present or no aura → JumpToAction 360. Then it runs until the shield ends (trigger shield_end: the jump 0–360 → 360); exclusiveFrame and MarkCanInterrupt 361. No DamageAction (its atk_scale / poise blackboard defaults are unused). The counter is allowed over its whole length.

skills.label: Shield up (hold, after a block)
skills.note: As loop_1, cast by the blocks and the shielded combo after a block.

skills.label: Shield: first block
skills.note: 25 frames; DamageAction disabled. Its effects: triggers block_1_cast and block_1_loop.

skills.label: Shield: later block
skills.note: 25 frames; DamageAction disabled. Triggers block_2_cast and block_2_loop.

skills.label: LEAVE MY FRIENDS ALONE! (headbutt)

hits.note: ChannelingAction [9–13]: SpellInfliction 3 (Nature), DamageAction atk_scale (4.0; damageType 6, mask 4352) with poise (20), BlowOffAction, ObtainCostAction atb_return / potential_5_atb (0 at every level) if a block happened. "headbutts a target in front of her to deal Nature DMG and apply Nature Infliction".

skills.note: The battle skill as changed for 10 s (counter_ready); 0 SP. Frame 0 ends the shield (trigger counter_cast).

skills.label: Combo: CAKE OR "PREZZIE"
skills.note: All its effects come from the giftbox (triggers giftbox*). Frame 0 IfElse: aura_block up → JumpToAction 210 (block_counter < 2) or 270 (after a block); unshielded it ends at 206 (InterruptCurSkillAction), cancellable from MarkCanInterrupt 28; the shielded paths go back to the loops (combo_shielded*_loop). Its three ComboSkill slow-downs (0, 210, 270): only the path's plays.

skills.label: Ultimate: NAUGHTY IS BANNED!
skills.note: Three Prezzies (triggers ult_rolls, ult_prezzies). The conditional JumpToAction 0 → 68 (box_num ≥ 1) isn't taken: both paths reach frame 138 70 frames after the cast; the jump 67 → 135 always is.
